meta.subject: fix hold_here issue in small/medium projects

en.summary: Fixes CDP end-of-cube progress counting so the residual channel counter advances by one boundary event instead of by datapath throughput in small and medium builds.
why_it_counts: The patch changes DUT state-update logic in the CDP buffer input datapath.
The bug is configuration-dependent and affects hold/done sequencing in small and medium projects.
The changed counter participates in cube completion logic rather than debug or test scaffolding.
evidence: In state CUBE_END, cube_end_c_cnt now increments by 1 when cube_end_width_cnt reaches last_width, instead of by NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT.
Nearby code shows cube_end_width_cnt and cube_end_c_cnt together feed cube_done generation for different throughput settings.
The same file uses hold_here and rdma2dp_ready_normal around this residual-drain sequencing, matching the commit message.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a residual-drain or end-of-cube state, a datapath often tracks width progress and channel progress separately before declaring the tile or cube done. The channel-progress counter should advance once per completed boundary event. If it instead advances by the datapath throughput constant, reduced-throughput configurations overcount progress and assert hold-release or done conditions on the wrong cycle.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Reduced-throughput builds or modes that enter a special tail-drain state and increment a channel/end counter only when a width-boundary condition is met.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Scale the tail-state channel counter by datapath throughput instead of by one completed boundary event.
portability_notes: Map the fault to the counter that gates residual completion, not the main streaming counter used in steady state.
This bug is easiest to expose when width and channel completion are nested and only the final width position should bump the channel-progress count.
If the DUT has build-time throughput options, validate on a smaller-throughput configuration because the overcount becomes visible sooner.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the control block that runs after the main data phase and waits for the final width position before advancing channel-level completion.
On the width-boundary event, replace the +1 update of the residual channel counter with an increment by the datapath throughput parameter or lane count.
Leave the surrounding width counter and done comparator unchanged so the fault manifests as premature or delayed completion.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: Inside stat_cur==CUBE_END, the fix changes cube_end_c_cnt from += NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT to += 1 when cube_end_width_cnt == last_width.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v, restore cube_end_c_cnt <= cube_end_c_cnt + NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT in the CUBE_END and cube_end_width_cnt==last_width branch.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Small or medium configurations overcount tail progress, causing hold_here or cube_done sequencing to fire on the wrong cycle and disturbing final cube drain behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The modified assignment sits exactly in the CUBE_END residual-count block.
Nearby generated code comments show cube_done compares cube_end_c_cnt against throughput-dependent constants.
The surrounding logic explicitly handles hold_here during residual drain, aligning with the reported symptom.
notes: This is a good reusable bug pattern for designs that treat completion as a nested width-by-channel count in a tail state.
Because the original fix is one assignment, a reverse patch is straightforward and localized.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CDP 的 cube 尾部进度计数：在 small/medium 配置下，残余通道计数器应按一次边界事件递增，而不是按 datapath throughput 跳增。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CDP buffer 输入数据路径中的 DUT 状态更新逻辑。
该缺陷与配置相关，会影响 small 和 medium 工程里的 hold/done 时序。
被修改的计数器参与的是 cube 完成判定，而不是调试或测试脚手架。
evidence: 在 CUBE_END 状态下，当 cube_end_width_cnt 到达 last_width 时，cube_end_c_cnt 现在按 1 递增，而不是按 NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT 递增。
附近代码表明 cube_end_width_cnt 与 cube_end_c_cnt 会一起参与不同 throughput 配置下的 cube_done 生成。
同一文件还在这段残余排空时序周围使用了 hold_here 和 rdma2dp_ready_normal，与提交信息完全吻合。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在残余排空或 cube 结束状态里，数据路径通常会分别跟踪 width 进度和 channel 进度，再决定 tile 或 cube 是否完成。channel 进度计数器应该在每次真正完成一个边界事件时只加 1。如果错误地按 datapath throughput 常数递增，那么低吞吐配置会过度计数，从而在错误的周期触发 hold 释放或 done 条件。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 尾部状态中的完成计数器更新
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 低吞吐配置或模式进入特殊尾部排空状态，并且只有在满足 width 边界条件时才推进 channel/end 计数器。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把尾部状态中的 channel 计数器改回按 datapath throughput 递增，而不是按一次完成事件递增 1。
portability_notes: 应把故障映射到控制残余完成判定的那个计数器，而不是 steady-state 主流数据计数器。
当 width 完成与 channel 完成是嵌套关系，而且只有最后一个 width 位置才应推进 channel 进度时，这个 bug 最容易暴露。
如果 DUT 支持编译期 throughput 选项，优先在较低 throughput 配置下验证，因为过度计数会更快显现。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到主数据阶段结束后、需要等待最后 width 位置才推进 channel 级完成的控制块。
在 width 边界事件上，把残余 channel 计数器的 +1 更新改成按 datapath throughput 参数或 lane 数递增。
保持周围 width 计数器和 done 比较器不变，使故障表现为过早或过晚完成。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDP 的 CUBE_END 残余计数更新逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 在 stat_cur==CUBE_END 且 cube_end_width_cnt == last_width 时，该修复把 cube_end_c_cnt 从 += NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT 改成了 += 1。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CDP_DP_bufferin_tp1.v 中，把 CUBE_END 且 cube_end_width_cnt==last_width 分支里的 cube_end_c_cnt <= cube_end_c_cnt + 1'b1 恢复成 + NVDLA_CDP_THROUGHPUT。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: small 或 medium 配置会在尾部阶段过度累计进度，导致 hold_here 或 cube_done 在错误周期触发，扰乱最终 cube 排空行为。
evidence_for_injection: 修改点正好位于 CUBE_END 的残余计数块内。
附近的生成代码注释显示 cube_done 会把 cube_end_c_cnt 与随 throughput 变化的常数比较。
周围逻辑明确在残余排空期间处理 hold_here，与提交中提到的问题完全一致。
notes: 对于那些在尾部状态下按 width×channel 嵌套计数完成的设计，这是一个很好的可复用故障模式。
原始修复只是一条赋值语句，因此反向注入非常直接且局部。
